title.heading:
PROTO SCROLLER
FIELD BRIEFING
title.story:
At 04:17, the city defense grid went silent.
Your prototype is the only unit still moving.
title.controls_body:
MOVE   {move_left} / {move_right}   •   Left stick / {pad_left} + {pad_right}   •   Mobile joystick
CHARGE  Hold {smash}, {pad_smash}, or Mobile SMASH; release to strike
DASH   {dodge}   •   {pad_dodge}   •   Mobile DASH   •   Double-tap {move_left} / {move_right} or flick twice.
title.field_note:
Weapons fire automatically after acquisition.
Bindings can be changed in SETTINGS.  /  AUTO SAVE
title.enemy_intel:
GROUND  Soldiers + tanks
AIR  Helicopters + rockets
title.run_protocol:
RUN PROTOCOL
Upgrades reset when you Retry.
title.footer_landscape: ONE BUTTON  //  MAXIMUM COLLATERAL  //  RUN-LOCAL UPGRADES
title.deployment_authorized: Deployment authorized. Opening the city corridor.
title.command_hook:
An evil organisation killed everyone you love...
it's payback time!
title.language_auto_tooltip: Follows your browser or operating-system language.
title.input_remap_hint: SELECT A BINDING, THEN PRESS A KEY OR GAMEPAD BUTTON. CONFLICTS SWAP.
title.input_remap_waiting: WAITING FOR INPUT · ESC CANCELS KEYBOARD CAPTURE

tutorial.move.title: MOVE THE PROTOTYPE
tutorial.move.body: Hold {move_left} / {move_right}, use the left stick or D-PAD, or drag the mobile joystick to advance.
tutorial.ground_smash.title: GROUND SMASH
tutorial.ground_smash.body: While nearly still, tap {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH for a radial impact. Hold up to 2 seconds, then release for up to 200% damage.
tutorial.jab_cross.title: STRIKE AT SPEED
tutorial.jab_cross.body: Build speed, then tap {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH to Jab-Cross forward. Hold and release to charge up to 200% damage.
tutorial.direction_dodge.title: DOUBLE-TAP DODGE
tutorial.direction_dodge.body: Double-tap {move_left} or {move_right}, flick twice, or press {dodge} / {pad_dodge} to dash through danger.
tutorial.complete.title: COMBAT UPLINK COMPLETE
tutorial.complete.body: Dash Amplifier upgrades this dodge. Keep moving; weapons fire automatically.

shop.score_warning: SPENDING REDUCES YOUR FINAL RAMPAGE SCORE.
shop.dialogue.business.body: Your Rampage Score is legal tender here. Every module or repair lowers the score you carry to the final record. Keep the glory, or spend it to survive—focus a product to inspect the change, then confirm the sacrifice.
shop.dialogue.residential.body: Rampage Score buys welds as cleanly as weapons. Repair now and surrender part of the legend, or leave scarred and keep every point.
shop.dialogue.entertainment.body: Your score is the stake and devastation is the prize. Spend it on impossible hardware, or walk out richer and considerably more mortal.
shop.dialogue.military.body: Requisition cost is deducted from Rampage Score immediately. Confirm only what the chassis needs; the Crownward will collect every weakness you keep.
shop.dialogue.royal.body: Last ledger before the cycle turns. Spend what remains on forbidden power, repair the damage, or carry every unspent point into the next war.

narrative.district.business.arrival: The Ledger Spine is laundering more than money. Break the first sealed annex and look behind the facade.
narrative.district.residential.arrival: Ashwater records show whole families erased from census rolls. Find out where they went.
narrative.district.entertainment.arrival: The Afterglow is broadcasting a carrier signal. Kill the stage lights; keep the memory intact.
narrative.district.military.arrival: The Iron Corridor is shipping living siege engines. Their manifest ends at the Crownward.
narrative.district.royal.arrival: Royal continuity signatures match your own chassis. This is where they kept the previous pilots.
narrative.transmission.dossier_recovered: Case file transmitted. Destruction with receipts — a dangerous improvement.
narrative.transmission.black_lab_reveale: That is no relief vault. It is a CHOIR black laboratory. Keep moving; the city just acquired a motive.
narrative.transmission.continuity: Chassis lost. Memory seed preserved. You are not the first PROTOS to receive this message.
